title: 第二十七章 雷鹏的招揽
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
侯紫刚走进门里，就感觉到风在呼啸，一左一右向他刺了过来。速度之快，是他未曾遇到过的。

    侯紫在岳州城当混混的六年，天天打架，单挑，群架，偷袭，反偷袭，那都是家常便饭。

    所以他打架经验都丰富很少有人比得上，何况现在借风了。

    所以他一听这风声，已知道这两人必是专修剑道的修士，所用的剑迅速且狠毒。就跟巷子里那个张屠夫一样，切入猪头那最软的地方，一刀致命。

    侯紫突然原地转了半圈，一左一右成了一前一后，往下一蹲，两把剑已擦着头皮滑过。

    手一抬，一记冲天炮已打中右方那人的下巴，已听到骨头碎裂的声音。三人中间忽然大风刮起，侯紫再次一旋转，腿一摆，左方那人已被踢得滚出好远。

    就在这时，前面屋里响起了响亮的掌声，一个粗矿带着豪放的声音传来：“侯公子莫怪，两个手下不懂事，不经我同意就出手试探，实在是抱歉。”

    话音刚落，一个足有八尺的大汉大跨步从屋里走了出来。一副络腮胡子分外的刺眼。

    左右两人哏哏唧唧的站起，一个托着下巴，一个捂着肩膀，正跟侯紫道歉。

    侯紫心想，嘿，这真跟岳州城一样啊，虽然是修士，怎么跟凡间黑帮一模一样！

    当即抱拳，说“好说好说，这位莫非是雷鹏雷帮主？”
content_en:
As soon as Hou Zi walked into the door, he felt the wind whistling, stabbing him from the left to the right.The speed was so fast that he had never encountered it before.

During the six years that Hou Zi worked as a gangster in Yuezhou City, fights, singles, group fights, sneak attacks, and counter-sneak attacks were commonplace every day.

Therefore, he has rich fighting experience and few people can match him, let alone now he is borrowing the wind.

So when he heard the news, he already knew that these two people must be monks specializing in swordsmanship, and the swords they used were fast and vicious.Just like that butcher Zhang in the alley, he cuts into the softest part of the pig's head and kills it with one knife.

Hou Zi suddenly turned half a circle on the spot, one to the left and one to the right. He squatted down, and the two swords were grazing his scalp.

As soon as he raised his hand, a cannon shot into the sky hit the man on the right in the chin, and the sound of broken bones was heard.Suddenly a strong wind blew among the three of them. Hou Zi spun again and swung his legs. The man on the left was kicked far away.

At this moment, there was loud applause in the room in front, and a rough voice came with a bold voice: "Young Master Hou, don't blame me. The two men are ignorant and tried to test me without my consent. I am really sorry."

As soon as he finished speaking, a tall man who was eight feet tall strode out of the room.A pair of beards are particularly dazzling.

The two people on the left and right stood up, one holding his chin and the other covering his shoulders, apologizing to Hou Zi.

Hou Zi thought to himself, hey, this is really the same as Yuezhou City. Even though he is a monk, he is exactly the same as a mortal gangster!

He immediately clasped his fists and said, "It's easy to talk, could this be the leader of the Lei Penglai gang?"
